en: A Reunion officer. This enemy is <@eb.danger>very dangerous</> and <@eb.danger>hard to take down</>.
A Reunion officer engaged in behind-the-lines operations, raids, and assassinations. Nimbly <@eb.key>passes through units that block her</>.
A Reunion officer and Sarkaz mercenary skilled with explosives.
Uses explosives that deal heavy Physical damage to friendly units
Uses more explosive packs when HP falls below half
Deals heavy Physical damage to the unit with the <@eb.key>highest Max HP</>. Greatly reduces the ATK of the unit with the <@eb.key>lowest Max HP</> and deals Arts damage to it
[Sand Chant] Deals heavy Physical damage to the unit with the highest Max HP on the field and all targets in a cross-shaped area around it
[Sand Prison] Reduces the ATK of the unit with the lowest Max HP on the field and nearby targets, and deals Arts damage over time
Enters with a Barrier that absorbs a large amount of Arts damage; DEF greatly increases while the Barrier exists
Damage dealt increases when HP is below 50%
Has a Barrier that absorbs Arts damage; Max HP and ASPD greatly increase while the Barrier exists
Uses a skill to directly seize the nearest non-enemy "Phonograph"
A giant mechanical monster piloted by the High Priest. Can destroy wooden stakes; when destroyed, ejects the pilot and self-destructs.
Ranged attacks deal splash damage; melee attacks deal higher damage
Periodically destroys Giant Mushroom or wooden stake tiles, making them undeployable
Self-destructs when HP reaches 0, inflicting a wide-area <$ba.stun>Stun</> and ejecting the pilot, the High Priest
Does not attack, cannot be blocked; takes True damage every second
When the Withered Knight dies, ATK, ASPD, and movement speed greatly increase
Attacks deal Physical damage to the target and units within 4 surrounding tiles
Charged attack that deals heavy Physical damage to the target and units within 4 surrounding tiles
When <Withered Knight> dies, ATK, ASPD, and movement speed greatly increase
When the Corrupted Knight dies, ATK, ASPD, and movement speed greatly increase
Fires explosive arrows at 3 targets that explode after a short delay, dealing heavy Arts damage to the target and units within 4 surrounding tiles
When <Corrupted Knight> dies, ATK, ASPD, and movement speed greatly increase

Warden form: <@eb.key>RES increased</>, attacks deal <@eb.key>Arts damage</>, does not attack Restraint Devices; Killer form: <@eb.key>DEF increased</>, attacks deal <@eb.key>Physical damage</>; <@eb.key>releases all enemies on the field</> upon entering Killer form
Attacks deal ranged Arts damage; does not attack Restraint Devices
Can <$ba.stun>Stun</> multiple units
Attacks deal melee Physical damage and ignore a portion of the target's DEF

A monster painted by Dusk. [Weaving Earth, Charting Heaven]: <@eb.key>alters friendly Light/Dark state</>. [Breaking Free]: if its shield is <@eb.key>not broken</>, deals <@eb.danger>massive AoE damage</>.
[Weaving Earth, Charting Heaven] Casts a cross-shaped Arts spell on the nearest target, changing the Light/Dark attribute within its area
[Breaking Free] Deals massive AoE damage if the Barrier is not broken

A member of the Deep Sea Church who slipped into post-catastrophe Iberia. Sincerely rewrote the law with their own ideals in pursuit of individual perfection, yet could never fathom the will of the ocean. Then again, who could?
[Spring Tide] Deals Arts damage and <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</> to all friendly units
[Fission Reproduction] Summons offspring that entangle friendly units and <$ba.stun>Stun</> them
Three-time champion of the Kazimierz Major, a Leithanian reject unable to use Arts, a born warrior: the Black Knight. <@eb.key>Passes through units that block her, dealing Physical damage</>
Immune to <$ba.frozen>Freeze</>, has <$ba.buffres>Resistance</>
Attacks against the unit blocking her ignore a portion of its DEF
[Swift Kill] When blocked, passes through the target and deals Physical damage to targets along the way
[Instant Killing Intent] For every 25% HP lost, drains the SP of friendly units in range and prevents them from attacking or healing for a period of time
The Lord of Wolves, born of the wilds, yet with its gaze turned to the human world.
Takes reduced damage, cannot be <$ba.stun>Stunned</>

[Hemolytic Dread] Engulfs 3 friendly units in fear: they cannot be manually retreated, ASPD is greatly reduced, and they lose HP at an accelerating rate; affected units return to normal when the "Lord of Wolves" loses a certain percentage of HP
After HP in the first form drops to 0, gains [Ancient Intimidation], reducing the ASPD of nearby friendly units and slowly restoring HP
No longer has damage reduction and no longer casts [Hemolytic Dread]
Periodically casts [Furious Howl], rapidly raising the Blood Debt
A Reunion officer encountered before, attacking with an impressively scorching longblade
